candidate.name: quarterly_joint_profit_revenue_growth_floor_rank
candidate.mechanism: conservative joint-growth floor from the raw minimum of two independently available point-in-time growth states, followed by a same-day cross-sectional percentile rank
candidate.formula: rank_pct(min(profit_yoy,revenue_yoy)) on the exact common finite two-field stock-day universe after strict-next-session activation

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quality_growth

nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: quality_growth averages separate cross-sectional percentile ranks; Campaign072 takes the raw lesser growth rate first and ranks that conservative floor afterward
